verification: R3-20-03 CONFIRMED by grep (not seen live). Others OBSERVED.
files: apps/web/src/pages/shell/transcript.tsx ('From routine: <name>')
apps/web/src/components/AskCard.tsx (show the chosen answer)
sidebar preview mapping for the AI-off error ('Waiting for AI to be allowed')
reach: Routine and bot users; polish.
acceptance: Routine messages carry 'From routine: <name>'.
The answered card shows the answer.
The AI-off preview fits one short line.

files: apps/web/src/components/tour/FirstRunTour.tsx (prefix 'Search:', fixed min-height on phones)
reach: Every new user.
acceptance: Step 1 names the Search box.
Drawer rows do not move between stops.

title: GTM page: the agent panel is open by default, and an empty 'Written by GTM agent' card flashes on load
root_cause: GTM opens with its panel docked while every other page opens full width, and the goal has both an Edit link and a chip in the panel. The 'Written by' section renders before data loads.
verification: OBSERVED (p-GTM.png, c8-gtm.png).
files: apps/web/src/pages/Gtm.tsx (render the section only with data; panel default)
reach: GTM users.
acceptance: No empty card on first load.
GTM opens like other pages, or the owner keeps the panel.
decision_question: Should GTM open with its agent panel closed like other pages (recommended), or stay open because the agent is the main way to set a goal?

title: Sidebar spaces: clicking the empty 'Reconnect needed' space header creates a Chief chat, and the Create menu offers 'New space' to a one-space user
root_cause: The header is a demo seed space (DEMO_FINANCE_RECONNECT_SPACE in packages/testkit/src/cli/demo/data.ts), and opening an empty space auto-creates a chat. The Pass-8 decision hides 'New space' until a second space or member exists; J3 found it in the Create menu.
verification: FLOW-02: header string traced to the seed, behaviour for a real empty space SUSPECTED. J3-05: SUSPECTED conflict with decision (may cover only the list).
files: apps/web/src/pages/Shell.tsx (space header click: open without creating a chat until the user writes)
apps/web/src/components/SidebarPages.tsx (Create menu)
reach: Multi-space users.
acceptance: Clicking a space header never creates data.
'New space' follows the Pass-8 rule.
decision_question: Does the Pass-8 rule (hide New space until a second space or member exists) also cover the Create menu? And should opening an empty space create a chat?
